fix.pr_body:
## What was missing

`/explain modmail` was not a recognized key in the explanations dict, so users had no way to get a quick explanation of how to use the ModMail bot via the slash command.

## What changed

Added a `'modmail'` entry to the `explanations` dict in `discordbot/commands/explain.py` (between `'league'` and `'netdecking'` in alphabetical order). The explanation tells users to DM the ModMail bot to reach mods privately, includes advice to state their MTGO username and a clear subject, and links to the ModMail usage guide.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit discordbot` — 845 passed, 1 skipped (functional test intentionally skipped), 0 failures

Fixes #11814
